articles.summary: LIVERMORE, Calif., Aug. 12, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — FormFactor, Inc. (Nasdaq: FORM) (the “Company” or “FormFactor”) today announced that Aric McKinnis, currently its Vice President and Corporate Controller, has been appointed to serve as the Company’s new Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. He succeeds Shai Shahar, who resigned from these positions effective August… Continue reading FormFactor, Inc. Announces CFO Transition
